# pixsame

> Visual regression testing for Cypress and Playwright. One manifest standard shared by both runners, a pinned renderer for byte-identical screenshots, forensic diff analysis and baseline approval in the pull request. Open source, MIT.

## Docs

- [Install](https://pixsame.com/docs/getting-started/install): add the Cypress plugin and take a first snapshot
- [Usage](https://pixsame.com/docs/getting-started/usage): configure matchImage, clean up unused baselines
- [Configuration](https://pixsame.com/docs/reference/configuration): every option of the Cypress plugin
- [Migrate from @frsource](https://pixsame.com/docs/getting-started/migrate-from-frsource): move to the @pixsame package
- [Cypress plugin](https://pixsame.com/products/cypress-plugin): overview and changelog
- [Manifest schema](https://pixsame.com/docs/reference/manifest): the runner-agnostic run manifest (`@pixsame/manifest`)

## Product

- [Products](https://pixsame.com/products): what pixsame does
- [Pricing](https://pixsame.com/pricing): Core is free; Team and Enterprise are coming soon
- [Changelog](https://pixsame.com/products/cypress-plugin/changelog): release notes for the Cypress plugin

## Status

- Available: Cypress plugin (`@pixsame/cypress-plugin-visual-regression-diff`), run manifest standard (`@pixsame/manifest`)
- Coming soon: Playwright plugin, GitHub App, hosted platform (server renderer, image and diff viewer, AI auto-evaluator)
